correctness.rationale: The connected Laplacian yields complementary firing sets, and threshold intervals give a bijection between cuts and primitive-two phase configurations. A 16-state mass-weighted transfer counts all labelled phases, with a row-exchange J for Möbius closing. Two independently implemented exact six-state determinants (SymPy and a 720-permutation standard-library polynomial expansion) produce the displayed factors, and the Lucas polynomial trace identity gives the signed coefficients in every degree for every n>=3. Separate explicit graph adjacency and full chip dynamics agree for all tested states at n=3,4, with cut-mass histograms at n=3..7. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Conserved chip total is intrinsic to the fixed-energy parallel chip-firing model. The unweighted parity law could conceal opposite signs at particular energies, so strict coefficientwise parity dominance is an independent structural assertion. The new binomial formula proves strict all-energy reversal for an infinite family, provides exact every-mass differences, and identifies a surprising size-independent central coefficient. This is useful for fixed-energy orbit sampling and boundary-response analysis without asserting new general cut identities or basins.
